Package com.eqixiac.equinix.design.optimizer.wizard.enums

package com.eqixiac.equinix.design.optimizer.wizard.enums
Configuration enums for the Deployment Wizard: BackboneTopology (how the recommended metros are meshed with inter-metro backbone links), BandwidthStrategy (how provider connections are sized from workload requirements), and ConnectionPurpose (what role a planned connection plays in the plan). The first two are levers on DeploymentWizard.Builder; the third is stamped on each PlannedConnection by the wizard.
